incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired -> service=infra-night-ops alert=high-queue-depth rule=route-by-timezone
liam: acked. I'm on infra-night, looking...
maria: @liam real quick — was this supposed to go to model-serving-night? I see matching alert id in model metrics but PD routed to infra-night-ops.
pagerduty-bot: PD-log: {"alert_id":"a-9f2c","source":"model-serving","target_service":"infra-night-ops","rule_id":"timez-route-23","escalation":"night-escalation"}
liam: hmm. I only saw the PD page. I already started investigating infra hosts — but logs show no saturation here. Could be a misbinding.
maria: pasted PD rule snippet — looks like the schedule tag 'tz:APAC' got duplicated onto the infra-night service yesterday via automated tagging job. That would cause the timezone router to pick infra-night for APAC-detected alerts.
ash (reacts): :eyes:
ashley: if model-serving alerts are landing on infra-night that's bad for triage — they won't be familiar with model indicators. Can infra team step back and we route to correct on-call? @jordan can you silence the infra page and re-route?
jordan: running silence now via pd-cli -> `pd incidents silence a-9f2c --service infra-night-ops --duration 30m`
jordan: command output: "Silence created: id=sg-334, expires_in=30m"
liam: thanks. I've aborted the host-level checks I started. No changes to infra.
maria: quick customer-impact check — querying metrics for model-serving: `sum(rate(model_inference_errors[5m])) by (customer_id)` returns spikes for two customers: cust-42 and cust-77. Latency p95 jumped from 200ms to 1.8s 5m ago.
ash (reacts): :rotating_light:
ash: @maria do we have evidence of failed requests (5xx) or just tail latencies?
maria: mostly 5xx for embedding endpoint, approx 0.8% of requests failing for the window. Not huge but noticeable for heavy customers.
ashley: OK — priority: get alert routed to model-serving-night oncall then confirm mitigation (rollback / autoscale / fix). Jordan, can you flip the PD routing for that rule to point to `model-serving-night`? And let's update the tagging job to not apply infra tags.
jordan: applying quick patch: `pd rules update timez-route-23 --target model-serving-night` -> output: "rule updated". Posting PR for tagging-job fix: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra-tag-fix/pull/128
pagerduty-bot: PD-log: incident a-9f2c reassigned to service=model-serving-night escalation=oncall-sre
sre-night: acked. I'm on it — collecting traces and scaling embeddings pool. First action: temp scale +10 replicas.
sre-night: running `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings --namespace=model-prod` now.
liam: good handoff. Anything we need infra to keep an eye on?
sre-night: nope, infra can stand down for this alert. Thanks for silencing.
maria: scale went through, p95 dropping to 450ms in latest 2m window. 5xx rate trending down. Customer notif? Support probably needs a heads-up for cust-42 and cust-77.
ash: I'll draft a short customer impact note. Nothing mitigated yet.
ash: Draft: "We observed elevated latency and intermittent 5xx errors affecting embedding endpoints for a subset of customers; routing rules inadvertently sent alerts to an unrelated on-call due to a tagging regression. Issue is mitigated by scaling; we're investigating a permanent fix and will follow up." Approve?
ashley: LGTM. Add ETA on root-cause: tag automation bug + PD rule brittle mapping.
maria: creating postmortem ticket and assigning owners: https://tickets.internal/INC-4421
jordan: merged tagging fix PR -> will deploy in the next pipeline.
shawn: we should run a PD replay and test for timezone edgecases. Filed follow-up: https://tickets.internal/TASK-2137
liam: note for runbook — add a step: if alert sources != expected service, immediately silence and reassign to avoid OOO responders getting paged.
ash: good capture. Closing note: alert routed wrong because `tz:APAC` tag accidentally applied to infra service by automated tag sync; fix deployed; customers saw elevated latency but reduced after scaling.
ashley: closing the thread. good quick recovery. :thumbsup:
